title: Session Start Receipt
description: Machine-produced session-start receipt (M5 phase 4, #3777): captures checkout identity (repo/branch/SHA relative to origin/main) and the inputs to the advisory staleness liveness check. Emitted by `cargo xtask session-receipt --json`. Advisory only -- `stale_warning` firing is visibility, not a build gate.

fetch_ok.description: Whether `git fetch origin main` succeeded. When false, origin_main_sha/behind_origin_main/ahead are all null -- fail-closed rather than silently reporting 0-behind.

warn_threshold.description: The commits-behind-origin/main threshold in effect when stale_warning was computed.

stale_warning.description: Populated only when behind_origin_main exceeds warn_threshold. Advisory text, never a build-blocking condition.
